sg_law_politics_law_mass_conscription = {
	value = 0
	every_interest_group = {
		limit = { is_in_government = yes }
		if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_mass_conscription value >= strongly_approve } } add = { value = ig_clout multiply = 60 } }
		else_if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_mass_conscription value >= approve } } add = { value = ig_clout multiply = 30 } }

		else_if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_mass_conscription value <= disapprove } } subtract = { value = ig_clout multiply = 30 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_mass_conscription value >= strongly_approve } }
		}
		add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_mass_conscription value >= approve } }
		}
		add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_mass_conscription value <= strongly_disapprove } }
		}
		subtract = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_mass_conscription value <= disapprove } }
		}
		subtract = 8
	}
	min = -50
	max = 50

	if = { limit = { any_interest_group = { is_powerful = yes law_stance = { law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed value <= strongly_disapprove } } } add = 12 }
	min = 0
	max = 60
}

sg_law_politics_law_child_labor_allowed = {
	value = 0
	every_interest_group = {
		limit = { is_in_government = yes }
		if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed value >= strongly_approve } } add = { value = ig_clout multiply = 60 } }
		else_if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed value >= approve } } add = { value = ig_clout multiply = 30 } }
		else_if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed value <= strongly_disapprove } } subtract = { value = ig_clout multiply = 60 } }
		else_if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed value <= disapprove } } subtract = { value = ig_clout multiply = 30 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed value >= strongly_approve } }
		}
		add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed value >= approve } }
		}
		add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed value <= strongly_disapprove } }
		}
		subtract = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed value <= disapprove } }
		}
		subtract = 8
	}
	min = -50
	max = 50
}

	value = "enactment_chance_for_law(law_type:law_child_labor_allowed)"
	multiply = 100
	min = 0
	max = 100

		add = { value = sg_law_politics_law_child_labor_allowed }
		subtract = { value = sg_law_risk_law_child_labor_allowed multiply = 0.5 }
		add = { value = sg_law_enactment_chance_law_child_labor_allowed multiply = 0.5 }
	}
	min = -100
	max = 200

	if = { limit = { any_interest_group = { is_powerful = yes law_stance = { law = law_type:law_census_voting value <= strongly_disapprove } } } add = 12 }
	min = 0
	max = 60
}

sg_law_politics_law_census_voting = {
	value = 0
	every_interest_group = {
		limit = { is_in_government = yes }
		if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_census_voting value >= strongly_approve } } add = { value = ig_clout multiply = 60 } }
		else_if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_census_voting value >= approve } } add = { value = ig_clout multiply = 30 } }
		else_if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_census_voting value <= strongly_disapprove } } subtract = { value = ig_clout multiply = 60 } }
		else_if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_census_voting value <= disapprove } } subtract = { value = ig_clout multiply = 30 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_census_voting value >= strongly_approve } }
		}
		add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_census_voting value >= approve } }
		}
		add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_census_voting value <= strongly_disapprove } }
		}
		subtract = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_census_voting value <= disapprove } }
		}
		subtract = 8
	}
	min = -50
	max = 50
}

sg_law_enactment_chance_law_census_voting = {
	value = "enactment_chance_for_law(law_type:law_census_voting)"
	multiply = 100
	min = 0
	max = 100
}

sg_law_score_law_census_voting = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sg_law_available_law_census_voting = yes }
		add = { value = sg_law_benefit_law_census_voting }
		add = { value = sg_law_politics_law_census_voting }
		subtract = { value = sg_law_risk_law_census_voting multiply = 0.5 }
		add = { value = sg_law_enactment_chance_law_census_voting multiply = 0.5 }
	}
	min = -100
	max = 200
}

		else_if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_council_republic value >= approve } } add = { value = ig_clout multiply = 30 } }
		else_if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_council_republic value <= strongly_disapprove } } subtract = { value = ig_clout multiply = 60 } }
		else_if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_council_republic value <= disapprove } } subtract = { value = ig_clout multiply = 30 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_council_republic value >= strongly_approve } }
		}
		add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_council_republic value >= approve } }
		}
		add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_council_republic value <= strongly_disapprove } }
		}
		subtract = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_council_republic value <= disapprove } }
		}
		subtract = 8
	}
	min = -50
	max = 50

	if = { limit = { average_sol < average_expected_sol } add = 5 }
	min = 0
	max = 100
}

sg_law_risk_law_women_own_property = {
	value = 5.0
	if = { limit = { any_interest_group = { is_powerful = yes law_stance = { law = law_type:law_women_own_property value <= strongly_disapprove } } } add = 12 }
	min = 0
	max = 60
}

sg_law_politics_law_women_own_property = {
	value = 0
	every_interest_group = {
		limit = { is_in_government = yes }
		if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_women_own_property value >= strongly_approve } } add = { value = ig_clout multiply = 60 } }
		else_if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_women_own_property value >= approve } } add = { value = ig_clout multiply = 30 } }
		else_if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_women_own_property value <= strongly_disapprove } } subtract = { value = ig_clout multiply = 60 } }
		else_if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_women_own_property value <= disapprove } } subtract = { value = ig_clout multiply = 30 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_women_own_property value >= strongly_approve } }
		}
		add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_women_own_property value >= approve } }
		}
		add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_women_own_property value <= strongly_disapprove } }
		}
		subtract = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ruler
			ruler = { law_enactment_stance = { law = law_type:law_women_own_property value <= disapprove } }
		}
		subtract = 8
	}
	min = -50
	max = 50
}

sg_law_enactment_chance_law_women_own_property = {
	value = "enactment_chance_for_law(law_type:law_women_own_property)"
	multiply = 100
	min = 0
	max = 100
}

sg_law_score_law_women_own_property = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sg_law_available_law_women_own_property = yes }
		add = { value = sg_law_benefit_law_women_own_property }
		add = { value = sg_law_politics_law_women_own_property }
		subtract = { value = sg_law_risk_law_women_own_property multiply = 0.5 }
		add = { value = sg_law_enactment_chance_law_women_own_property multiply = 0.5 }
	}
	min = -100
	max = 200
}
